ai_opportunities.name: Cross-System Sync Engine
ai_opportunities.description: Wire HubSpot ↔ ERP ↔ IoT ↔ billing with AI workflows — eliminate manual data sync between systems

value_saved.description: Eliminates manual data reconciliation between CRM, ERP, and billing systems

value_created.description: Real-time data consistency across systems, faster deal-to-delivery cycle
value_created.potential_revenue_impact: 10-15% faster revenue recognition from automated invoicing

connect_and_automate.approach: Build a Claude workflow that monitors HubSpot deal closures via webhook, auto-generates invoices in Exact Online via API, provisions devices in IoT platform, and updates all systems in real-time
pros: Uses your existing HubSpot + Exact stack
Fully customized to your deal flow
cons: Requires API access to all systems

enhance_with_ai.approach: Deploy AI orchestration layer that learns your deal patterns, auto-detects sync errors, handles exception cases, and provides a unified data dashboard across all systems
cons: Needs training data from historical deals

targeted_upgrade.when_needed: Only if your ERP has no API or your CRM fundamentally cannot handle B2B deal structures

ai_opportunities.recommendation_rationale: Your HubSpot and Exact Online both have full API access. A Claude workflow connecting deal closures to invoice generation ships in under a week and eliminates 15+ hours of manual reconciliation per week.

roi_example.scenario: B2B platform company with 50+ deals/month, 3 people doing manual data sync
roi_example.value_created: Eliminate 15 hours/week of manual sync, reduce invoice errors by 90%
roi_example.assumptions: Assumes API access to CRM and ERP, typical deal complexity, some edge cases still need human review

agent_opportunity.what_it_does: Monitors deal events in HubSpot, auto-generates Exact Online invoices, provisions IoT devices, and reconciles discrepancies. Starts in approval mode, graduates to autonomous for standard deals.

ai_opportunities.name: Predictive Parts Inventory
ai_opportunities.description: Use IoT usage data to forecast consumable needs and auto-trigger reorders before stockouts

value_saved.description: Eliminates manual inventory checks and emergency orders

value_created.description: Reduced stockouts, optimized inventory levels, lower carrying costs

connect_and_automate.approach: Build a Claude workflow that pulls device usage data from IoT platform, calculates consumption rates, forecasts when parts will be needed, and auto-generates purchase orders
cons: Needs historical consumption data for accuracy
Requires supplier API or email integration

enhance_with_ai.approach: Deploy predictive AI model that learns from device-specific usage patterns, seasonal trends, and failure rates to optimize inventory across all locations

targeted_upgrade.when_needed: Only if you have no IoT usage data or your inventory is purely spreadsheet-based
cons: May not integrate with custom IoT

ai_opportunities.recommendation_rationale: You already have rich IoT usage data. A Claude workflow connecting device consumption patterns to your ERP's purchase order system ships in under 2 weeks and prevents stockouts.

ai_opportunities.name: Smart Technician Routing
ai_opportunities.description: AI-optimized field service scheduling that considers location, skills, parts availability, and priority

value_saved.description: Reduces scheduling time and optimizes technician utilization

value_created.description: More jobs per day, lower travel costs, faster resolution times

connect_and_automate.approach: Build a Claude workflow that takes incoming service requests, matches to available technicians by location and skill, checks parts availability, and generates optimized daily routes
pros: Integrates with your existing field service app
cons: Requires API access to scheduling system

enhance_with_ai.approach: Deploy AI scheduling agent that learns from historical service patterns, predicts job duration, and dynamically adjusts routes as new urgent requests come in

targeted_upgrade.when_needed: Only if you have no field service app or are using spreadsheets for scheduling
cons: May not fit your custom workflows

ai_opportunities.recommendation_rationale: You already have a custom field service app. Building AI routing on top of it preserves your team's workflow while dramatically improving efficiency.

connect_and_automate.approach: Build a Claude workflow that processes partner install requests, auto-provisions devices in IoT platform, creates billing records in ERP, schedules installation, and sends confirmation to all parties

enhance_with_ai.approach: Deploy AI agent that handles the full onboarding lifecycle including site assessment, optimal device configuration recommendations, and proactive issue resolution

ai_opportunities.name: Usage-Based Billing Automation

cons: May not handle your specific IoT data format

enhance_with_ai.approach: Deploy predictive AI model that learns from historical churn patterns, scores account health in real-time, and triggers automated CS playbooks for at-risk accounts

enhance_with_ai.approach: Deploy AI CS agent that learns which interventions work best for different account types, personalizes messaging, and optimizes timing for maximum impact
